## AnchoredPopupLayer

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/panel/anchored_popup_layer/anchored_popup_layer.hpp>
class AnchoredPopupLayer final : public Panel
```

AnchoredPopupLayer is a renderer-neutral retained popup boundary tied to a live anchor. It owns one content control, resolves and updates bounded client-relative geometry, centralizes click-away and Escape dismissal requests, and projects dialog semantics while the Window retains the actual popup lease.

Status: stable. No WinForms counterpart.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `AnchoredPopupLayer(StableId stable_id, Control::Ptr anchor, AnchoredPopupPlacement placement = {})` | Constructs a full-client popup boundary around a required live anchor and validated placement policy. |
| `Control::Ptr anchor() const noexcept` | Returns the current strong anchor reference used for geometry and ownership association. |
| `void set_anchor(Control::Ptr anchor)` | Validates and replaces the anchor, then resolves geometry against the next arrangement. |
| `Control::Ptr content() const noexcept` | Returns the optional retained control hosted inside the resolved popup bounds. |
| `void set_content(Control::Ptr content)` | Replaces the single content role with normal parent/attachment bookkeeping and layout invalidation. |
| `AnchoredPopupPlacement placement() const noexcept` | Returns the caller-authored popup geometry policy. |
| `void set_placement(AnchoredPopupPlacement placement)` | Validates and commits placement policy, then invalidates geometry and semantics. |
| `AnchoredPopupPlacementResult resolved_placement() const noexcept` | Returns the last arranged bounds and side/clamping result. |
| `bool dismiss_on_click_away() const noexcept` | Reports whether primary presses outside resolved bounds request dismissal. |
| `void set_dismiss_on_click_away(bool enabled)` | Toggles click-away policy without changing popup ownership. |
| `bool dismiss_on_escape() const noexcept` | Reports whether Escape preview requests dismissal. |
| `void set_dismiss_on_escape(bool enabled)` | Toggles Escape policy without changing focus or popup leases. |
| `Event<PopupDismissReason>& dismiss_requested() noexcept` | Returns the event carrying click-away or Escape reason for the owning coordinator to close. |
| `Size measure(Size available) override` | Consumes the available client boundary while measuring content against preferred popup size. |
| `void arrange(Rect final_bounds) override` | Resolves placement against live anchor/client geometry and arranges content inside exact bounded results. |
| `bool hit_test_local(Point local_point) const override` |  |
| `void on_pointer(PointerEvent& event) override` | Detects qualified outside primary presses, raises dismissal, and prevents click-through. |
| `void on_key_preview(KeyEvent& event) override` | Intercepts Escape before descendants when enabled and raises a typed dismissal request. |
| `SemanticDescriptor semantic_descriptor() const override` | Projects a transient dialog boundary with expanded content ownership. |

(api-gui-forms-tooltip)=
## ToolTip

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/components/tool_tip/tool_tip.hpp>
class ToolTip final : public Component
```

ToolTip is a nonvisual window-bound provider that tokenizes help text to live controls and coordinates hover/focus/manual presentation through one scheduler-backed state machine. It owns delayed show, reshow, auto-pop, movement tracking, popup revocation, input-transparent overlay composition, configurable maximum width, and exact visibility events.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `ToolTip`.

- Maps help text to live controls through tokenized `set_tool_tip`, lookup, removal, and clear operations.
- Initial, reshow, and auto-pop delays, hover/focus enablement, and `show_always` are retained policies; explicit persistent or duration-bounded show and immediate hide are available.
- Presentation is an input-transparent overlay-plane popup anchored to the target or the pointer and repositioned live when the owner moves; a stable semantic `tool_tip` node is published.
- Popup and timer cleanup is synchronous when a mapping, target, provider, or Window goes away. Accessible described-by relations and title/icon/balloon variants remain open.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit ToolTip(Window& window)` | Binds a nonvisual tooltip provider to one live Window lifetime and creates its UI-thread scheduler. |
| `~ToolTip() override` | Closes overlays and releases target, timer, popup, and lifetime subscriptions before destruction. |
| `void set_tool_tip(const std::shared_ptr<Control>& target, std::string text)` | Validates a live target, tokenizes or replaces its help text, installs movement/input subscriptions, and removes empty mappings. |
| `std::string tool_tip(const Control& target) const` | Returns authored help text for a currently mapped target. |
| `bool remove_tool_tip(const Control& target)` | Disconnects one target mapping and hides it first when it owns the visible or pending tooltip. |
| `void clear()` | Hides any overlay and disconnects every mapped target. |
| `std::chrono::milliseconds initial_delay() const noexcept` | Returns the hover/focus dwell required for a fresh tooltip. |
| `void set_initial_delay(std::chrono::milliseconds delay)` | Validates nonnegative timing and updates future fresh-show scheduling. |
| `std::chrono::milliseconds reshow_delay() const noexcept` | Returns the shorter delay admitted after a tooltip was recently hidden. |
| `void set_reshow_delay(std::chrono::milliseconds delay)` | Validates nonnegative timing and updates future reshow scheduling. |
| `std::chrono::milliseconds auto_pop_delay() const noexcept` | Returns the default visible duration before automatic hiding. |
| `void set_auto_pop_delay(std::chrono::milliseconds delay)` | Validates positive timing and re-arms an active automatic hide. |
| `bool show_on_hover() const noexcept` | Reports whether mapped pointer entry may schedule presentation. |
| `void set_show_on_hover(bool value)` | Toggles hover policy and cancels incompatible pending hover work. |
| `bool show_on_focus() const noexcept` | Reports whether mapped keyboard focus may schedule presentation. |
| `void set_show_on_focus(bool value)` | Toggles focus policy and cancels incompatible pending focus work. |
| `bool show_always() const noexcept` | Reports whether inactive-window targets are still eligible for presentation. |
| `void set_show_always(bool value)` | Toggles inactive-window eligibility and re-evaluates current presentation. |
| `double maximum_width() const noexcept` | Returns the logical wrapping ceiling used to measure tooltip bubbles. |
| `void set_maximum_width(double width)` | Validates a bounded width, then remeasures and repositions any visible bubble. |
| `void show(const std::shared_ptr<Control>& target)` | Immediately presents a mapped target with either default or caller-supplied duration using the common overlay path. |
| `void show(const std::shared_ptr<Control>& target, std::chrono::milliseconds duration)` | Immediately presents a mapped target with either default or caller-supplied duration using the common overlay path. |
| `void hide()` | Cancels pending work and closes the active overlay with a hidden event. |
| `bool visible() const noexcept` | Reports whether both visible target and connected popup lease remain live. |
| `std::shared_ptr<Control> active_control() const noexcept` | Returns the target currently owning visible presentation, if any. |
| `Event<const ToolTipEvent&>& visibility_changed() noexcept` | Returns the event published after a tooltip becomes visible or hidden. |

(api-gui-forms-anchoredpopupplacement)=
## AnchoredPopupPlacement

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/panel/anchored_popup_layer/anchored_popup_placement/anchored_popup_placement.hpp>
struct AnchoredPopupPlacement final
```

AnchoredPopupPlacement is the caller-authored geometry policy for preferred size, horizontal alignment, preferred vertical side, gap, viewport margin, and optional vertical flipping. It contains no transient ownership or rendering state.

**Data members**

```cpp
Size preferred_size{};
double gap{};
double viewport_margin{4.0};
bool allow_vertical_flip{true};
```

(api-gui-forms-anchoredpopupplacementresult)=
## AnchoredPopupPlacementResult

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/panel/anchored_popup_layer/anchored_popup_placement/anchored_popup_placement.hpp>
struct AnchoredPopupPlacementResult final
```

AnchoredPopupPlacementResult is the exact output of placement resolution: client-relative bounds plus whether the popup moved above its anchor or had either dimension clamped.

**Data members**

```cpp
Rect bounds{};
bool placed_above{};
bool width_clamped{};
bool height_clamped{};
```

(api-gui-forms-tooltipevent)=
## ToolTipEvent

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/components/tool_tip/tool_tip.hpp>
struct ToolTipEvent final
```

ToolTipEvent is the immutable publication payload for a tooltip visibility transition. It names the stable target, carries the presented text, and records shown/hidden and keyboard/pointer origin without exposing overlay internals.

**Data members**

```cpp
std::string target_stable_id;
std::string text;
bool shown{};
bool keyboard_initiated{};
```
